concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a refined square desktop app icon for GitDove, a professional Git GUI.
Create ONE finished app icon, no presentation board, no labels. The essential idea is a dove physically carrying a Git branch in its beak.
Design direction AERO: a beautifully reduced, highly distinctive ivory-white dove in flight, with a generous upswept wing, a compact rounded head, short beak, and clean tapering tail. Construct the bird with confident flowing silhouette geometry, at most three broad feather tips and one carefully placed negative-space wing cut. Sophisticated modern identity design, highly legible at 32 pixels, not a generic stock dove, not a detailed bird illustration.
The dove grips a compact coral-orange Git branch symbol by its exposed stem. The branch must clearly have a main line with two circular commit nodes and a single curved offshoot ending at a third circular commit node. The fork must be fully visible and separate from the body. Make the connection between the beak and stem unambiguous. All three nodes equally sized, generous line weight. No leaves or botanical twig.
An emerald rounded-square tile supports the mark: deep forest emerald at the bottom subtly graduating to brighter jade at the top. White bird and warm coral graph create excellent contrast. Flat vector-like mark, meticulous curves, optical balance, no outlines, no fake 3D, no extraneous detail. The subject fills roughly 70% of tile width.
Composition: centered icon, front view, square canvas. Tile occupies 88% of canvas width and height with consistent generous rounded corners and transparent margin outside. All subject details comfortably inside the tile. Crisp, high resolution, polished final design.
No words, no letters, no watermark, no mockup scene, no secondary symbols, no border ornaments, no checkerboard. Transparency outside the opaque rounded-square icon.
concepts.refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is an edit target: an already finished GitDove app icon.
Make only one correction: clean the silhouette of the outer rounded-square tile and its transparent surround. Remove ALL disconnected colored specks, fringe, haze, ragged alpha, and smudges outside the rounded square. There must be only one immaculate smooth rounded-square silhouette on a completely clean transparent exterior, with proper crisp antialiasing. No pixels or glow floating outside it.
Preserve the existing dove, its shape, pose, wing details, colors, the Git branch with exactly three circular nodes, the beak contact, the background color and shading, composition and overall style. Do not redesign the artwork inside the tile. Keep the transparency outside the tile. Keep a generous even transparent margin. Do not add any words, frames, outlines, objects or checkerboard. Final polished app-icon artwork.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a refined square desktop app icon for GitDove, a professional Git GUI.
Create ONE finished premium app icon, no presentation board, no labels. The essential idea is a dove physically carrying a Git branch in its beak.
Design direction PORCELAIN: a tactile ivory porcelain dove with simple, plump, elegant sculptural volumes, one broad raised wing and a smaller far wing, small round head with one tiny dark eye, short beak and a compact fan tail. This is a dignified, beautifully crafted desktop app symbol, not a cartoon toy and not a realistic feathered bird. A few broad overlapping feather planes, beautifully controlled ceramic satin finish, subtle bevels and delicate ambient occlusion. The silhouette should still be strong when reduced to 48 pixels.
The bird visibly holds a warm tangerine-orange enameled Git branch in its beak. The Git branch is a sturdy little sculptural object with one main stem joining two circular commit nodes, and a single curved fork reaching a third circular commit node. Exactly three equally sized commit nodes and one visible fork, no leaves, no decorative wires. All three nodes and the fork stay clearly visible against the blue tile. The branch hangs naturally below the beak with some clear negative space around it, never floating disconnected.
Background: a rich cobalt-blue rounded-square tile, slightly luminous indigo toward the base, gently beveled with restrained depth. White porcelain against cobalt, tangerine graph accent. Front-on view with a slight three-dimensional elevation of the bird from the tile; soft studio light from upper left, precise restrained contact shadows. Beautiful material quality and immaculate silhouette.
Composition: centered, square canvas, tile occupies 88% of canvas with transparent outer margin, consistent generous rounded corners. Bird and branch together occupy around 72% of the tile. A single complete icon fully in frame.
No text, no letters, no watermark, no scenery, no display stand, no photo mockup, no extra objects, no sparkles, no checkerboard. Transparency outside the opaque tile.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a refined square desktop app icon for GitDove, a professional Git GUI.
Create ONE finished app icon, no presentation board and no text. Essential idea: a dove carrying a Git branch in its beak.
Design direction FOLD: an iconic ivory dove made from four or five broad folded-paper planes, combining elegant origami geometry with a clearly recognizable dove. Dynamic ascending flight, a tall triangular wing with an elegant folded tip, a softly angular small head with a short beak, full dove breast, and a clean split tail. Keep proportions avian and gentle, not an airplane, not an eagle, not a checkmark. The near wing is warm white, the rear wing light sand, and one narrow fold is pale peach. Precision geometry, large quiet facets, no individual feathers, no tiny details. Give paper planes just enough dimensional shading to separate them while maintaining an essentially graphic logo.
The dove holds a dark aubergine Git branch symbol by a small projecting stem in its beak. The branch uses a main line connecting two round commit nodes and one 45-degree offshoot ending in a third equally sized round node. Exactly three circular nodes, clear fork topology, firm monoline weight, entire graph visible against the background, physically connected to the beak. No leaves, no botanical details.
Background: a refined warm terracotta / burnt-coral rounded-square tile with an extremely subtle tonal gradient. The ivory origami bird and dark aubergine Git graph create a distinctive, confident, warm design. Impeccable negative space and optical balance. Graphic clarity at 32 and 48 pixels is essential.
Composition: single centered icon, front view, square canvas. Rounded square tile occupies 88% of canvas width and height, generous consistent rounded corners, transparent margin outside. The whole dove and branch occupy roughly 72% of tile. Keep tips clear of tile edges. Crisp, polished final design.
No words, no letters, no watermark, no mockup scene, no bevel on tile, no noisy textures, no extra objects, no checkerboard. Transparency outside the opaque tile.
